architecture.intended_loop: PAYMENT_FAILED -> CONTEXT -> DIAGNOSE -> SCORE -> DECIDE -> POLICY CHECK -> EXECUTE -> VERIFY -> RECOVER / ESCALATE / STOP
architecture.actual_implementation: Fully implemented across ContextBuilder, DecisionService, PolicyEngine, PreFlightGuard, ToolExecutor, and PaymentTruthResolver
architecture.isolation_boundary: LLM receives structured context only; has no tool-calling capability, no external network access, and no Razorpay API credentials; communicates exclusively via structured JSON validated by Zod schema AIDecisionOutputSchema
architecture.policy_firewall: Deterministic PolicyEngine evaluates 9 checks immediately following AI decision and immediately before tool dispatch; PreFlightGuard evaluates live obligation state at millisecond of tool execution

critical_schema_drift.details: The persisted database at data/recoverai.db is missing the recovery_url column in table recovery_cases, and missing 6 columns in table decisions ('failure_category', 'recoverability', 'expected_recovery_value', 'timing', 'reason', 'customer_friction'). In src/db/database.ts, runMigrations() only checks and alters for 'obligation_id' in recovery_cases and audit_events, completely omitting migrations for the other newly added columns. In-memory unit tests pass because they execute SCHEMA_SQL from scratch, masking this fatal runtime bug.

precedence_model.tier_5: UI_STATE / CLIENT_INPUT (Zero authority over financial truth)

payment_truth.verified_interrupt: When an authoritative capture event is ingested, PaymentTruthResolver marks PaymentObligation SATISFIED and immediately calls cancelPendingActionsForObligation(), cancelling all pending/claimed recovery actions.

obligation_model.order_cardinality: One-to-one between commercial order and PaymentObligation. Multiple failed payment attempts (and recovery cases) map to the exact same obligation_id.
obligation_model.evaluation: Genuinely separates obligation from ephemeral payment attempts.

idempotency.db_enforcement: UNIQUE index on idempotency_key in both recovery_actions and tool_executions tables
idempotency.worker_leasing: claimActionForExecution() uses atomic conditional SQL update: UPDATE recovery_actions SET status='CLAIMED', claim_worker_id=?, claim_expires_at=? WHERE id=? AND (status='POLICY_ALLOWED' OR (status='CLAIMED' AND claim_expires_at < ?))

deterministic_checks: Check 1: Case is still open (not in terminal RECOVERED or STOPPED status)
Check 2: Commercial payment obligation is not already SATISFIED
Check 2b: Decision proposal is not stale (created within max 5 minutes)
Check 3: Customer has not opted out (consent_status !== 'OPTED_OUT')
Check 4: Action is in allowed vocabulary and merchant policy configuration
Check 5: Required diagnostic evidence is present
Check 6: Tiered amount policy (under ₹5,000 autonomous, ₹5,000–₹25,000 1 bounded intervention, above ₹25,000 human review)
Check 7: Max interventions / retry limit not exceeded
Check 8: Hard decline category match (prohibits direct retry on EXPIRED_CARD, STOLEN_CARD, CARD_BLOCKED, etc.)
Check 9: Confidence threshold check (confidence >= merchant min_confidence_for_autonomous_action)
policy_engine.human_review_bypass: IMPOSSIBLE. Human operator action in handleHumanReview() constructs an operator decision and explicitly runs through PolicyEngine.evaluate(). If an operator approves a direct retry on an expired card or an opted-out customer, the policy engine rejects the operator action.

ai_layer.default_client: MockLLMClient (deterministic mock based on observable features)
ai_layer.validation: AIDecisionOutputSchema (Zod) validates diagnosis, failure_category, recoverability, expected_recovery_value, recommended_action, timing, confidence, reason, customer_friction, evidence
ai_layer.failure_handling: Bounded retry (up to 2 retries) upon malformed JSON; safe deterministic system_fallback upon exhaustion

critical_dead_code.details: CommunicationLedgerManager.canContactCustomer() contains cooldown and contact frequency logic, but it is NEVER invoked anywhere in RecoveryControlLoop, PolicyEngine, or ToolExecutor. The control loop unconditionally calls recordAttempt() without calling canContactCustomer().

benchmark.dataset: Seeded Mulberry32 PRNG (seed=42), 5,000 total cases, 2,500 held-out test split, 6 payment archetypes

flaws_and_anomalies.issue: PolicyOnlyStrategy crippled by omission of ESCALATE handling
flaws_and_anomalies.details: PolicyOnlyStrategy sets actionToExecute = policyCheck.allowed ? ruleAction : 'STOP'. When policy returns ESCALATE, policyCheck.allowed is false, so it sets actionToExecute = 'STOP'. In contrast, recoverai_hybrid explicitly handles else if (policyCheck.policy_result === 'ESCALATE') actionToExecute = 'ESCALATE'. This artificially crushes Policy-Only recovery to 2.68% (₹15,45,919) compared to 80.82% for Fixed Rules and 80.95% for Hybrid, creating a misleading baseline comparison.

flaws_and_anomalies.issue: LLM-Only and RecoverAI Hybrid have 100% identical gross recovered revenue
flaws_and_anomalies.details: Both strategies achieve exactly ₹4,68,99,220.35 in gross recovered revenue down to the paisa. This occurs because MockLLMClient already encodes the safe failure category decisions, and for the 94 opt-out cases, LLM-Only is penalized to ₹0 by LatentEngine while Hybrid blocks them to ₹0. Thus both recover ₹0 on those 94 cases.

flaws_and_anomalies.issue: Extremely small incremental net uplift over fixed rules
flaws_and_anomalies.details: RecoverAI Hybrid net revenue is ₹4,67,74,971.56 vs Fixed Rule Baseline net of ₹4,66,97,039.35, representing an uplift of only +₹77,932.21 (+0.17%). The pitch cannot claim substantial double-digit recovery uplift over rules on this benchmark.

security.secret_leakage: CLEAN. No secret values found in source code or committed git history.
security.sql_injection: SAFE. All queries use parameterized statements (?) via DatabaseSync.
security.arbitrary_tool_execution: BLOCKED. ToolExecutor only executes actions matching ApprovedActionSchema enum.
security.prompt_injection_resistance: PASS. Untrusted text is treated strictly as passive data string in ContextBuilder and does not override enum-bounded decision schemas.
security.webhook_signature_verification: IMPLEMENTED via HMAC-SHA256 crypto.timingSafeEqual(). Note: passes through if no secret configured and in mock mode.

tests.blind_spot: All tests run against in-memory SQLite (createMemoryDatabase()), allowing the missing columns on the disk database (data/recoverai.db) to go undetected by CI.

findings.title: Database schema drift in data/recoverai.db crashes live runtime APIs
findings.description: The disk database data/recoverai.db is missing column recovery_url in recovery_cases and 6 columns in decisions. Calling POST /api/simulator/trigger, POST /api/razorpay/create-test-recovery, or ingesting a webhook crashes with HTTP 500.

findings.title: Consumer recovery page (/recover/[id]) permanently broken by object wrapping mismatch
findings.description: src/app/recover/[id]/page.tsx line 37 accesses data.data.case, but GET /api/cases/[id] returns { success: true, case: c } without a 'data' wrapper. This throws an uncaught TypeError, permanently rendering 'Payment Session Not Found'.

findings.title: Policy-Only strategy artificially crippled by broken ESCALATE branch
findings.description: In src/evaluation/strategies/policy-only.ts line 78, cases requiring escalation are assigned action 'STOP' instead of 'ESCALATE', collapsing its recovery rate to 2.68% and distorting the benchmark comparison.

findings.title: Mock LLM Client encodes policy rules, causing identical gross revenue between LLM-Only and Hybrid
findings.description: MockLLMClient checks is_high_value, max_retries, and failure categories internally, which duplicates policy rules and results in identical gross recovery (₹4,68,99,220) between LLM-Only and Hybrid.

findings.title: CommunicationLedgerManager.canContactCustomer() is dead code
findings.description: The 15-minute cooldown and contact frequency limit logic is implemented in canContactCustomer() but is never called anywhere in the execution loop.

findings.title: RazorpayAdapter.retryPayment() always delegates to in-memory simulator
findings.description: Even when live test keys are configured, RazorpayAdapter.retryPayment() delegates to fallbackSimulator.retryPayment() because Razorpay REST API does not support single-call customer card retries.

must_fix: Fix runMigrations() in src/db/database.ts to check and add missing columns ('recovery_url' to recovery_cases; 'failure_category', 'recoverability', 'expected_recovery_value', 'timing', 'reason', 'customer_friction' to decisions), or wipe/recreate data/recoverai.db so runtime APIs do not crash with 500.
Fix src/app/recover/[id]/page.tsx line 37 to read data.case || data.data?.case so the customer recovery checkout page renders properly.
Fix src/evaluation/strategies/policy-only.ts to handle policy_result === 'ESCALATE' by setting actionToExecute = 'ESCALATE', restoring policy-only strategy to its legitimate performance.
Wire canContactCustomer() into RecoveryControlLoop before calling recordAttempt() to ensure communication cooldown is actively enforced.

Ensure the demo script and benchmark pitch do not overclaim recovery uplift (accurately state +0.17% net uplift and highlight the real win: eliminating 94 policy violations and ₹94,000 in regulatory/network penalties).
recommended: Add an integration test running against the actual data/recoverai.db disk file in addition to :memory: to catch migration drift.
Persist SimulatorAdapter payment links and payments to SQLite rather than in-memory Maps so that simulated entities survive server restarts.
Add visual indicators on the dashboard and case pages showing whether the active backend provider is Razorpay Test Mode or Simulator Mode.
Include a 'Reset Demo Database' button in the dashboard to seed clean initial demo records.
production_hardening: Migrate from in-process SQLite conditional updates to distributed Redis locks / leases for multi-instance horizontal scaling.
Replace immediate synchronous webhook execution with an asynchronous queue (e.g. BullMQ / Inngest) with exponential backoff and dead-letter queues.
Implement real communication channels (WhatsApp Cloud API / Twilio SMS) with webhook delivery receipts and statutory opt-out unsubscription links.
Integrate Razorpay webhook replay tolerance window (reject events with created_at older than 24 hours).

submission_readiness.summary: RecoverAI possesses an outstanding, production-shaped architecture that rigorously adheres to the principle 'AI proposes, Policy controls, Tools execute, Verified events determine truth'. Its payment obligation model, truth precedence hierarchy, deterministic idempotency, and 60-test verification suite are top-tier. However, two critical runtime bugs (SQLite disk schema drift crashing failure ingestion with 500, and an object-path bug in the consumer recovery page) and two benchmark integrity issues (crippled policy-only baseline and identical gross revenue) must be resolved before submission.
